Study_Hours.label: How many hours do you study on a normal day?
Study_Hours.tip: Long study days with no breaks can pile up. Try blocks of about 25-50 minutes with short breaks.

Class_Attendance.label: What percentage of your classes do you attend?
Class_Attendance.tip: Missing many classes can make catching up stressful. If something is stopping you, talk to your tutor early.

Exam_Frequency.label: How often do you have exams or tests? (1 = rarely, 9 = very often)
Exam_Frequency.help: Your own rating on a 1-9 scale.
Exam_Frequency.tip: Put every exam date in MindSync so busy weeks are visible early.

Assignment_Load.label: How heavy is your assignment workload? (1 = light, 9 = very heavy)
Assignment_Load.help: Your own rating on a 1-9 scale.
Assignment_Load.tip: Break big assignments into small tasks with their own deadlines.

Sleep_Hours.label: How many hours do you sleep on a normal night?
Sleep_Hours.help: Average over the last few weeks.
Sleep_Hours.tip: Regular sleep is one of the most reliable ways to cope with a heavy workload.

Social_Media_Use.label: How many hours a day do you spend on social media?
Social_Media_Use.tip: Notice when scrolling replaces a break you actually needed.

Screen_Time.label: How many hours a day are you in front of a screen in total?
Screen_Time.help: Phone, laptop, TV and games together.
Screen_Time.tip: Look away from screens for a few minutes every hour.

Physical_Exercise.label: Do you exercise regularly?
Physical_Exercise.help: The dataset recorded this as a Yes/No answer.
Physical_Exercise.tip: Even a short walk between study blocks can help.

Peer_Pressure.label: How much pressure do you feel from your classmates or friends? (1 = none, 9 = a lot)
Peer_Pressure.help: Your own rating on a 1-9 scale.
Peer_Pressure.tip: Comparing yourself with others rarely shows the full picture. Focus on your own plan.

Family_Support.label: How supported do you feel by your family? (1 = not at all, 9 = completely)
Family_Support.help: Your own rating on a 1-9 scale.
Family_Support.tip: If support at home is low, a friend, tutor or student services can fill part of that gap.

Anxiety_Level.label: How anxious do you usually feel? (1 = calm, 9 = very anxious)
Anxiety_Level.help: Your own rating on a 1-9 scale.
Anxiety_Level.tip: If anxiety is getting in the way of daily life, please talk to someone you trust or a counsellor.
